question: Is maternity treatment covered from day one of this policy?
gold_rationale: Maternity is subject to a 36-month waiting period; it is not covered until that period is served.

clause: Co-payment of 10% shall be applicable for every claim if treatment is taken outside India.
question: Do I have to pay part of the claim myself if I am treated outside India?
gold_rationale: A 10% co-payment is imposed on every claim for treatment taken outside India; cover exists but is subject to that co-pay.

clause: ii. Code- Excl05: Exclusion Name: Rest Cure, rehabilitation and respite care
question: Is rest cure or rehabilitation care covered by the policy?
gold_rationale: Rest Cure, rehabilitation and respite care is an express standard exclusion with no grant or carve-back.
expected_citation: Rest Cure, rehabilitation and respite care

question: Is maternity treatment covered under the standard exclusions?
gold_rationale: Maternity is expressly listed as a standard exclusion (Excl18); any cover would only arise via a separate opted add-on after its waiting period, which is not assumed here.

clause: 1. Initial waiting period: 30 days for all illnesses (except Hospitalization due to injury).
question: Can I claim for an illness in the first week of the policy?
gold_rationale: All illnesses carry an initial 30-day waiting period (except injury-related hospitalisation); cover only attaches after it.

clause: 3. Pre-Existing Diseases: Declared & accepted Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage.
question: Are my declared pre-existing conditions covered immediately?
gold_rationale: Declared and accepted pre-existing diseases are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage.

question: Is there a deductible I must pay before the policy pays a claim?
gold_rationale: The policy states the deductible is Not Applicable, so no deductible amount is subtracted before cover applies.

clause: k. Any injury or illness caused by or arising from or attributed to war, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, commotion, unrest, rebellion, revolution
question: Is an injury caused by war or invasion covered?
gold_rationale: Injuries/illnesses caused by war, invasion, acts of foreign enemies and related hostilities are expressly excluded.
expected_citation: war, invasion, acts of foreign enemies

clause: Domestic Road Ambulance Cover: Cashless Actuals; Reimbursement 1% of Sum Insured, maximum up to Rs 10,000.
question: Will the policy pay for an ambulance to take me to hospital?
gold_rationale: Domestic Road Ambulance Cover is a granted benefit, but it is capped (reimbursement up to Rs 10,000 or 1% SI), so cover is conditional on that sub-limit, not open-ended likely_covered.

clause: Donor Expenses - for an organ donor's Hospitalization for any organ donated to the Insured Person, up to Annual Sum Insured.
question: Are the medical expenses of the organ donor covered if I need a transplant?
gold_rationale: Donor Expenses for an organ donor's hospitalization are expressly covered up to the Annual Sum Insured.

clause: Day Care Procedures/Treatment - All Day Care procedures covered.
question: Are day-care procedures that don't need a 24-hour admission covered?
gold_rationale: All Day Care procedures are expressly covered, including those under 24 hours, so this is a granted benefit.

clause: In Patient AYUSH hospitalisation Upto Annual Sum Insured.
question: Does the policy cover inpatient treatment under AYUSH systems of medicine?
gold_rationale: Inpatient AYUSH hospitalisation is expressly covered up to the Annual Sum Insured.

question: Is there a cap on the room rent I can claim?
gold_rationale: The policy states there is no room rent capping, so room rent is covered without a sub-limit.

clause: Domiciliary Hospitalization - Covers the Medical Expenses incurred in respect of the Domiciliary Hospitalization.
question: Are domiciliary expenses (treatment at home) covered?
gold_rationale: Domiciliary Hospitalization expenses are expressly covered.

clause: Maternity Cover & New Born Baby Cover Not Applicable for Annual Sum Insured 3 Lacs; Maternity Limit: ...
question: Am I covered for maternity and newborn expenses?
gold_rationale: Maternity & New Born Cover is not applicable for lower sum-insured tiers (e.g. 3 Lacs) and is subject to a Maternity Limit and waiting period for applicable tiers, so cover is conditional on the sum-insured tier/waiting period, not outright excluded.
expected_citation: Maternity Cover & New Born Baby Cover

clause: Preventive Health Check-Up As per Annual Sum Insured package eligibility.
question: Can I claim a preventive health check-up?
gold_rationale: Preventive Health Check-Up is covered as per the Annual Sum Insured package eligibility, so it is conditional on the eligibility tier, not a flat grant.
